summary: E2E testing of Covoiturage SB Pay escrow flow (iter338). Found and fixed a CRITICAL frontend compile error (duplicate carpoolAPI export in services/api.js), then validated full e2e: driver publishes trip, client books 2 seats (40€ debited from wallet 3000→2960), Mes trajets shows passenger card with tel: link + cancel button, cancel refunds fully (3000), re-book debits 40 again, driver completes and gets +34€ (500→534 = 40-15% commission). Regression: insufficient balance shows error and does NOT debit; own ride booking is rejected with clear message ('Vous ne pouvez pas réserver votre propre trajet'). Backend pytest 4/4 PASS.
action_items: NOTE: The route is /carpool (not /covoiturage as stated in the review request). The link in SearchOverlay.js and clientRoutes.jsx uses /carpool. If 'covoiturage' URL is desired by product, add an alias route.
Stale duplicate carpoolAPI declaration was REMOVED from /app/frontend/src/services/api.js (lines 462-468). E1 should be aware this was a previous-iteration leftover.
Consider hiding the 'Réserver' button on own rides in the UI as a UX improvement (backend already rejects with 400).
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: /app/frontend/src/services/api.js had carpoolAPI exported twice (lines 463 and 1060). The stale one (with createRide/searchRides/bookSeat names) was causing the whole frontend to fail to compile. Removed the stale block.
carpool.py is well-structured: atomic seat reservation, rollback on insufficient balance, idempotent cancel, escrow released only on /complete. Auto-release loop (12h) is a good safety net.
Code review: route declared as /carpool but copy/translations and the review request use 'covoiturage'. Minor inconsistency; consider /covoiturage alias for SEO/UX clarity.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 carpool rides during test (Fort-de-France→Le Marin 20€/seat, Big A→Big B 999€/seat). Wallets remain in expected post-test state (client 2960€, driver 534€).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend route for carpool is /carpool (NOT /covoiturage). Login flow: /login → click 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' → 'Email' → fill email+password. All data-testids in CarPoolPage.js work correctly: tab-search, tab-mine, publish-trip-btn, publish-{from,to,when,seats,price,submit}, book-trip-<id>, book-modal, book-seats-{minus,plus,count}, book-total, book-confirm, mine-pax-<id>, mine-driver-<id>, call-driver-<id>, cancel-booking-<id>, complete-ride-<id>, cancel-ride-<id>. Wallet API: GET /api/wallet returns {balance}.
rca_of_the_issue: Frontend failed to compile with 'Identifier carpoolAPI has already been declared' because two `export const carpoolAPI = {...}` blocks existed in api.js (lines 463 and 1060). The duplicate at line 463 was from a previous iteration with outdated method names. Removed it; frontend now compiles and all e2e flows pass.
